title: OrganizerBillingCycleDocument
description: Where one organizer's rolling billing cycles stand (#1126). The daily cycle bill run writes it in the same transaction as each cycle's bill, so a cycle is billed at most once. Cycles chain: the next cycle starts where the last one closed, so a change to commission.cycleDays changes only cycles not yet billed. A cycle with nothing to bill advances the pointer without a bill. Server-only.

trialEndsAtMillis.description: The trial end the first cycle was anchored at, fixed when the first cycle was billed.

countFromMillis.description: No payment captured before this is billed by a cycle: the later of the trial end, the end of the organizer's last calendar-month bill, and 1 November 2026, India time.
